title: The Higher You Go The More We See
paragraphs: I found out something years ago, you know, when you rise to the top, everybody can see under. You better have clean clothes. Under clothes I'm talking about. The higher you go, THE MORE YOU SEE. YOU GOT CORRUPTION, THAT all comes out. Clean up your inner parts. Your secret life. God will rise you up high and expose you publicly, and you won't be ashamed. Thank you very much. God bless you.
